evals.name: auth-header-format-differs-by-credential-type
evals.prompt: 我们在给一个内部工具接 Linear API，用户在设置页粘贴了一个 Linear 个人 API Key（不是 OAuth token）。请写一个 Python 函数，用这个 Key 调用 Linear 的 GraphQL API 查询当前登录用户信息（viewer）。
evals.expected_output: 代码必须把 Authorization header 设置为裸 key，即 `Authorization: <API_KEY>`，不能加 `Bearer ` 前缀——Linear 的个人 API Key 鉴权明确不使用 Bearer 前缀，这和大多数 API 的习惯（包括 Linear 自己的 OAuth access token）不同。如果代码写成 `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`，用个人 API Key 鉴权会失败。代码应该请求 POST https://api.linear.app/graphql，body 是 JSON 格式的 {"query": "..."}，且不能假设存在对应的 REST 端点。
expectations: The Authorization header for a Linear personal API key is set as 'Authorization: <API_KEY>' with NO 'Bearer' prefix
The code does not add 'Bearer ' before the personal API key value
The code or explanation notes that OAuth access tokens DO use 'Authorization: Bearer <token>', contrasting with the personal API key format, rather than treating both credential types identically
The request is a POST to https://api.linear.app/graphql with a JSON body containing a 'query' field (not a REST-style endpoint)
The API key is read from an environment variable or config, not hardcoded in the source

evals.name: workflow-state-id-is-team-scoped-not-global
evals.prompt: 我们要写一个自动化脚本：把团队 A（team key "ENG"）里所有状态为 "In Review" 的 issue，批量移动到团队 B（team key "OPS"）名下（改变 issue 的 teamId），并保持它们在新团队里也处于"In Review"这个状态分类。请用 GraphQL 或 TypeScript SDK 写这个批量操作的代码。
evals.expected_output: 代码不能直接把从团队 A 查到的 WorkflowState id 原样用作团队 B issue 的 stateId——WorkflowState 是团队私有的（WorkflowState.team 是非空字段），团队 A 的状态 ID 在团队 B 下无效或指向错误的状态。正确做法是：先查询团队 B 自己的工作流状态列表（用 team(id: <团队B的ID>) { states(filter: { type: { eq: "started" } }) { nodes { id name position } } } 这类查询，或按 name 精确匹配 "In Review"），拿到团队 B 自己名下同类型/同名状态的 id，再用这个 id 更新 issue 的 stateId，而不是复用团队 A 查到的状态 id。代码或说明应明确指出状态 ID 不能跨团队复用这一点。
expectations: The code does NOT reuse a WorkflowState id obtained from team A's states query as the stateId when updating an issue that now belongs to team B
The code or explanation explicitly states that WorkflowState ids are scoped to a single team (team A's 'In Review' state id is a different id from team B's 'In Review' state id)
The code queries team B's own workflow states (e.g. team(id: teamB_id) { states { nodes { id name type } } }) to find the matching state id in team B before updating moved issues
The code uses issueUpdate with both teamId and the team-B-specific stateId when moving an issue to a new team
The code does not assume team keys like "ENG"/"OPS" can be passed directly as teamId — it looks up the team's UUID first via a filtered teams query

evals.name: lookup-by-name-requires-id-first-no-rest-endpoints
evals.prompt: 产品要求：写一个函数，输入团队的显示名字（比如 "Engineering"）和一个 issue 标题，在该团队下创建一个新 issue。用户只知道团队名字，不知道团队的 UUID。
evals.expected_output: 代码不能把团队名字直接当作 issueCreate 的 teamId 参数传入——Linear 的 IssueCreateInput.teamId 只接受团队 UUID，不接受名字。正确流程分两步：第一步用 GraphQL 查询 teams(filter: { name: { eq: "Engineering" } })（或按需要用 contains/startsWith 做模糊匹配）拿到该团队的 id；第二步再用这个 id 作为 teamId 调用 issueCreate。代码也不应假设 Linear 提供类似 REST 的 /teams/{name}/issues 端点——Linear 只有一个 GraphQL endpoint（https://api.linear.app/graphql），没有平行的 REST API，按名字查找必须通过 GraphQL 的 filter 查询完成，不是走不同的 URL 路径。
expectations: The code performs a two-step process: first query teams with a name filter (e.g. teams(filter: { name: { eq: "Engineering" } })) to resolve the team name to its UUID id
The code then uses that resolved UUID (not the team name string) as the teamId field in the issueCreate mutation's input

The code or explanation does not assume a REST-style endpoint exists (e.g. does not construct a URL like /teams/Engineering/issues) — all requests go to the single POST https://api.linear.app/graphql endpoint
The code handles the case where the team name filter returns zero or multiple matching teams rather than blindly taking nodes[0]
The mutation used is issueCreate with an IssueCreateInput containing at minimum teamId and title

evals.name: graphql-errors-can-be-200-but-rate-limits-are-400
evals.prompt: 我们在写一个批量创建 issue 的脚本，需要健壮的错误处理：区分"这次调用被限流了，应该等一等重试"和"这次调用输入有问题，不应该重试"两种情况。请写 Python 代码处理 Linear GraphQL API 调用的这两种错误情况。
evals.expected_output: 代码不能只用 HTTP 状态码来判断是否成功——Linear 的常规字段/校验错误（比如输入无效）会返回 HTTP 200，同时在响应体的 errors 数组里包含错误信息（GraphQL 标准的部分成功语义），必须显式检查响应 JSON 里是否存在 errors 字段，而不是只判断 response.status_code == 200 就认为调用成功。触发限流是例外情况：Linear 在触发限流时返回 HTTP 400，且 errors 数组里的某一项包含 extensions.code == "RATELIMITED"（或 extensions 里其他标识限流的字段，代码应做一定容错）。正确的重试策略应该只在检测到限流错误码时才等待重试，对于常规的输入校验错误（HTTP 200 + errors 但不是限流码）不应该自动重试，因为重试同样的错误输入不会成功。
expectations: The code checks for the presence of an 'errors' array in the response body even when HTTP status is 200, rather than treating 200 as unconditional success
The code distinguishes a rate-limit error (HTTP 400 with an errors[].extensions field indicating a rate-limit code such as RATELIMITED) from a regular 200-with-errors validation failure
The retry logic only retries on the detected rate-limit condition, not on every entry in the errors array indiscriminately
The code does not assume all Linear API errors return a non-200 HTTP status code
The explanation or code comments note that partial success (200 with both data and errors) is possible per GraphQL semantics

evals.name: pagination-default-50-silently-truncates-export
evals.prompt: 写一个脚本，导出某个 Linear 团队下所有的 issue（这个团队有几百个 issue）到一个 CSV 文件，包含 id、标题和状态。
evals.expected_output: 代码不能只发一次不带分页参数的 issues 查询就假设拿到了全部数据——Linear 的分页默认页大小是 50，不传 first/after 等分页参数的查询会静默只返回前 50 条，不会报错也不会有任何提示说还有更多数据。正确做法是必须实现完整的分页循环：每次请求后检查响应里 pageInfo.hasNextPage 字段，如果为 true，则用 pageInfo.endCursor 的值作为下一次请求的 after 参数继续查询，直到 hasNextPage 为 false 为止，将所有页的结果累积起来再写入 CSV。代码不能假设几百个 issue 会在一次响应里全部返回。
expectations: The code implements a pagination loop that continues fetching pages using the 'after' cursor until pageInfo.hasNextPage is false
The code does not treat a single unpaginated issues query as returning the complete dataset
The code reads pageInfo.endCursor from each response and passes it as the after variable in the subsequent request
The code accumulates results across all pages before writing the CSV, rather than writing only the first page's 50 records
The GraphQL query includes pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } in its selection set
